items.title: Pentair (PNR) Is Buying Taco Group To Expand Into HVAC And Data Centers
items.summary: Pentair (NYSE:PNR) has entered a definitive agreement to acquire Taco Group Holdings. The deal extends Pentair's reach into HVAC and data center markets while adding to its sustainable water solutions lineup. This transaction represents a new corporate development that is separate from earlier earnings and guidance reset updates. Pentair is known for water treatment and sustainable water solutions, and the planned acquisition of Taco Group Holdings adds a new dimension to that core...
